require(_fK2AMM[0] < 0, \"_fK2AMM[0] must be negative\");\n        require(_fK2AMM[1] > 0, \"_fK2AMM[1] must be positive\");\n        require(_fk2Trader > 0, \"_fk2Trader must be positive\");\n\n        int128[2] memory fEll;\n        // downward stress scenario\n        fEll[0] = (_fK2AMM[0].abs().add(_fk2Trader.mul(_fCoverN))).mul(\n            ONE_64x64.sub((fStressRet2[0].exp()))\n        );\n }\n\n    /**\n     *  Calculate additional/non-risk based slippage.\n     *  Ensures slippage is bounded away from zero for small trades,\n     *  and plateaus for larger-than-average trades, so that Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

pause().details: Triggers stopped state. Requirements: - The contract must not be paused.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

unpause().details: Returns to normal state. Requirements: - The contract must be paused.

governance().details: Returns the address of the governance.

maintainer().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

setImplementation(address).details: to delete module deploy a dummy module with the same name in getFunctionList() as being deleted it will remove all previous implementation functions

transferGovernance(address).details: Transfers governance mandate of the contract to a new account (`newGovernance`). Can only be called by the governance.

transferMaintainer(address).details: Transfers maintainer mandate of the contract to a new account (`newMaintainer`). Can only be called by the governance.

setImplementationCrossModules(address).details: allows replacement of functions from other modules. Use only if you realize consequences.
